intervals.label: CDEX-10 operation
intervals.note: Open interval: the first physics data began 26 Feb 2017 (C10-B1 data February 2017 - August 2018). No source read states whether data taking continues in 2026: papers through 2026 analyse the 2017-18 data set (205.4 kg day). The 2018 paper planned a move into a 1700 m^3 liquid-nitrogen tank at CJPL-II by the end of 2018; no source read confirms it.
intervals.quote: Data taking with C10B-Ge1 was performed from February 26, 2017 to November 7, 2017.

summary.plain: CDEX-10 is the second stage of the CDEX programme: ten kilograms of germanium crystals bathed in liquid nitrogen in the Jinping underground laboratory in China. It searches for very light dark matter and has set limits down to a few MeV.
summary.technical: Array of 10 kg of p-type point-contact germanium detectors (triple-element strings) immersed directly in liquid nitrogen; physics data from 26 Feb 2017 (C10-B1: Feb 2017 - Aug 2018, 160 eVee threshold). First results 102.8 kg d: SI 8e-42 cm^2 and SD 3e-36 cm^2 at 5 GeV/c^2; 205 kg d later used for sub-GeV, exotic and ultraheavy dark matter searches.
